profile.description: National Bank of Kuwait S.A.K.P., together with its subsidiaries, provides financial and investment services and solutions to individual, corporate, and institutional clients in Kuwait, the Middle East, North Africa, Europe, the United Kingdom, and internationally. It operates through six segments: Consumer Banking, Corporate Banking, NBK Wealth, Islamic Banking, Group Center, and International Banking. The company offers consumer loans, credit cards, trade finance, deposits, foreign exchange and advisory, and other related services. It also provides a full range of asset management, custody, brokerage, lending, and other customized and banking services to high-net-worth individuals and institutional clients. In addition, the company offers Islamic banking products and services; investment products; and treasury services and products. National Bank of Kuwait S.A.K.P. was incorporated in 1952 and is headquartered in Kuwait City, Kuwait.
